title: Axolotl with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water tint background-free; axolotl body -->
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q35 82 30 70 Q26 60 36 58 Q44 60 50 66 Z' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <path d='M50 78 Q35 82 30 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffc4dd' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffd6e8'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M29 30 Q16 22 14 30' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 38 Q14 36 13 44' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 46 Q18 50 20 56' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M71 30 Q84 22 86 30' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 38 Q86 36 87 44' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 46 Q82 50 80 56' fill='none' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gill tips -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <!-- gentle smile -->
  <path d='M44 46 Q50 50 56 46' fill='none' stroke='#d95a90' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='37' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a2b4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='37' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='34' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M33 29 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M66 27 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M50 20 l0.8 2 2 0.8 -2 0.8 -0.8 2 -0.8 -2 -2 -0.8 2 -0.8 Z' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='45' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fc0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='45' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fc0' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
